candle_closed_ohlc.name: candle_closed_ohlc
candle_closed_ohlc.value: "candles"."is_closed"=true AND "candles"."open">0 AND "candles"."low">0 AND "candles"."volume">=0 AND "candles"."high">=greatest("candles"."open","candles"."close") AND "candles"."low"<=least("candles"."open","candles"."close") AND "candles"."high">="candles"."low"

candle_timeframe_alignment.name: candle_timeframe_alignment
candle_timeframe_alignment.value: CASE "candles"."timeframe" WHEN '1m' THEN "candles"."close_time"-"candles"."open_time"=60000 AND "candles"."open_time"%60000=0 WHEN '5m' THEN "candles"."close_time"-"candles"."open_time"=300000 AND "candles"."open_time"%300000=0 WHEN '15m' THEN "candles"."close_time"-"candles"."open_time"=900000 AND "candles"."open_time"%900000=0 WHEN '1h' THEN "candles"."close_time"-"candles"."open_time"=3600000 AND "candles"."open_time"%3600000=0 WHEN '4h' THEN "candles"."close_time"-"candles"."open_time"=14400000 AND "candles"."open_time"%14400000=0 ELSE false END

trade_quantities.name: trade_quantities
trade_quantities.value: "trade_lifecycles"."requested_quantity">0 AND "trade_lifecycles"."filled_quantity">=0 AND "trade_lifecycles"."filled_quantity"<="trade_lifecycles"."requested_quantity" AND "trade_lifecycles"."closed_quantity">=0 AND "trade_lifecycles"."closed_quantity"<="trade_lifecycles"."filled_quantity" AND "trade_lifecycles"."protected_quantity">=0 AND "trade_lifecycles"."protected_quantity"<="trade_lifecycles"."filled_quantity"-"trade_lifecycles"."closed_quantity"

trade_prices.name: trade_prices
trade_prices.value: "trade_lifecycles"."entry_reference">0 AND "trade_lifecycles"."initial_stop">0 AND "trade_lifecycles"."desired_stop">0 AND "trade_lifecycles"."take_profit">0 AND ("trade_lifecycles"."average_entry" IS NULL OR "trade_lifecycles"."average_entry">0) AND ("trade_lifecycles"."confirmed_stop" IS NULL OR "trade_lifecycles"."confirmed_stop">0)
